zh: 本轮没有得到达到目标的可靠新R0。选中t1983726可加载并已实际训练1,121步、1,983,726目标token，但不建议替换原P15作为综合DAPO正式基座。独立128句chrF++47.789→48.797（差值95%CI[-0.999,2.829]），BLEU27.172→28.045（区间亦跨零）；通用chrF++44.431→42.020，超过预设容许下降。G8确认有正确候选16/64→17/64，技术中句6/24→4/24、长句2/24→4/24；greedy确认正确16/64→16/64。新G8还有16组U、31组确认全错：即使把全部U算正确也仅33/64，仍低于原定39/64；长句4P+7U=11/24，也低于12/24。因此不通过不依赖把U误算成错。训练已知困难句5/32→12/32且NLL下降，但仍未充分掌握；专门小集重复拟合30/32证明这批句子可学，不证明全面泛化或全局容量上限。当前有证据的瓶颈是候选能力与正式训练内掌握不足；仅换MetricX不能为31组全错候选补出正确译文。本轮无DAPO和MetricX调用，不能用它定量归因上次DAPO下降。继续SFT是否有效仍须以训练掌握与开发泛化共同决定，不能许诺加轮数必然解决。
en: This run did not produce the requested reliable new R0. The loadable t1983726 adapter received 1,121 updates / 1,983,726 target tokens, but is not recommended to replace P15 as a broad-task DAPO baseline. On the independent 128-source matched panel, chrF++ rises 47.789→48.797 (delta95%CI[-0.999,2.829]) and BLEU27.172→28.045 (CI also crosses zero), while general chrF++ falls44.431→42.020 beyond the predeclared tolerance. Confirmed G8 coverage rises16/64→17/64, medium6/24→4/24 and long2/24→4/24; greedy confirmed P stays16/64. There are16 uncertain and31 confirmed-all-wrong G8 groups. Even accepting every U yields33/64, below39/64; long4P+7U=11/24 remains below12/24. Failure does not depend on treating uncertainty as error. Hard train-known P improves5/32→12/32 and reference NLL falls, but acquisition remains incomplete. The separate tiny-set model reached30/32, establishing learnability of those sources, not broad generalization or a global capacity ceiling. Candidate capability and incomplete acquisition are evidenced bottlenecks; changing MetricX alone cannot create a correct candidate in31 all-wrong groups. This run makes no DAPO or MetricX calls and cannot causally apportion the preceding DAPO regression. Further SFT must be judged on both acquisition and held-out transfer; more epochs are not a guaranteed remedy.
